acceptanceCriteria.text: The same sources build the same way on every supported host through the project's build tooling, with the behavior each TR-MCP-NUKE-* requirement specifies; verified by running ./build.ps1 -WhatIf (TR-MCP-NUKE-005), which exits zero on a conforming tree.

result.notes: Operator, 2026-10-10T20:08:04Z, verbatim: "FR: Project will provide tooling for repeatable builds." and "Now, the TR are implementation detail of the FR." The Nuke build (build/, ./build.ps1) is that tooling; its behavior is specified only in TRs under this FR (TR-MCP-NUKE-*), consistent with "NUKE is only accountable through TR." Build.Tests is the infrastructure suite that verifies those TRs, not application unit tests; no TEST record.
result.title: Tooling for repeatable builds
result.description: The project SHALL provide tooling for repeatable builds.
